title: LifeOS 1.2.0
message: Bug fixes and improvements: export sharing, planner confirmations, recurring form, and more.
changelog:
- Export now shares file immediately after writing
- Date window filtering in all export types
- Delete confirmations across Planner screens
- Recurring rules: amount is now optional
- CSV import: file picker now shows all files
- SMS access banner no longer fires on every screen open
- Various UI and data accuracy fixes
